curiosities: PET stands for Personal Electronic Transactor, a name chosen to echo the pet rock fad.
The first PET of 1977 had a calculator-style keyboard and a built-in cassette deck.
Its PETSCII graphic characters were printed on the keys.
Chuck Peddle, who co-designed the 6502, designed it.
Commodore showed it at the Consumer Electronics Show in January 1977.
Its screen and keyboard are built into one metal case.
It was popular in schools, especially in Canada and the UK.
